column1:
getByLabel('label-text')
To locate elements based on the (label text, aria-label attribute, aria-labelledby)

Either tag or Attribute
<Label> - Tag 
aria-label - Attribute
column2:
Preferred for forms fields scenarios
Resolve the input associated with it automatically
column4:
getByLabel('First name', { exact: true })    //Label  (text)
getByLabel('Your name')   //aria-label  (value)
getByLabel('First:')      //aria-labelledby  (text)

// ⚠️ aria-describedby is DESCRIPTION not LABEL
// getByLabel does NOT read aria-describedby!)
locator('input[aria-describedby="hint1"]')    (or)
locator('[aria-describedby="hint1"]')  (value)
column5:
For multiple same label names
1.Either use .first() next to locator
2.Or going ahead with the getByrole
